beats.label: Check the bundle for real — and meet the gate
beats.cue: Assertion ok, install ok — then the boot stops at THREDZ_API_KEY and names it. GREEN, exit 0: --check scrubs the environment, so a credential the spec declares is reported as a gate, not a failure. Exporting the key changes nothing.
beats.script: Assertion ok, install ok — then the boot stops at THREDZ_API_KEY and names it. GREEN, exit 0: --check scrubs the environment, so a credential the spec declares is reported as a gate, not a failure. Exporting the key changes nothing. [[pause:1.5s]] No credentials are involved in this check; a clean exit confirms the local path behaves as described. GREEN (exit 0): assertion ok (11 anchors); install ok; boot gated (boot reached its MCP server credentials gate full boot needs the MCP server credentials the spec declares).

verify.note: GREEN (exit 0): assertion ok (11 anchors); install ok; boot gated (boot reached its MCP server credentials gate — full boot needs the MCP server credentials the spec declares). The boot still exits 21 internally because the synthesized thredz MCP server declares a required THREDZ_API_KEY; factory PR #345 (audit item 9) reclassified that from a structural boot failure to a recognised credential gate, so this beat asserted exit 1 against 0.4.0 and earlier. The same $THREDZ_API_KEY ref in daemon.yaml (channel shape) was already gated-green — the fix removed that inconsistency. Measured both ways — with the key exported the output is byte-identical, because --check boots with a scrubbed env and an empty --env-file. No env scrub needed here to be deterministic.

beats.command: echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"paper_buy","arguments":{"symbol":"AAPL","qty":50,"playbook":"breakout-pullback","thesis":"Base breakout on volume; exit back inside the base."}}}' | bun mcp/paper-broker.ts > live/broker.jsonl

verify.note: no key, no network: paper_buy validates thesis/playbook/stop before it ever fetches a quote, and a rejected order writes no ledger state. The boot banner (mode=paper seed=$5000) prints on stderr, the reply lands in live/broker.jsonl.
